reviews.text: They have a good selection of products.

I used the dog run at Toyosu LaLaport. The grass was beautifully maintained, and the dogs seemed to be having a great time running around. As a dog owner, I was happy to be able to let my dog ​​play with peace of mind.

Previously, when entering the dog run, we used a type of collar that hung around the neck, but now it's been changed to a wristband. The wristband is neater, and there's less worry about it getting caught when picking up or lifting the dog, so I personally found it more convenient.

The staff were all very kind, making for a pleasant experience. However, the dog run is sometimes closed for grass maintenance and repairs, so it's recommended to check the website for announcements before going. I think it's a dog run where you and your dog can have a great time.
I think 800 yen for 30 minutes at a dog run is really expensive. Maybe an hour would be acceptable... There are plenty of free dog runs in Tokyo, so I won't be going there again.

The price was quite high, including the animal, insurance, and goods.
The price dropped by 220,000 yen in two weeks.

I went to the dog run at Lalaport Toyosu with my dog.

It's divided into a small dog area and an all-breed area, and my dog ​​had a blast.

The gently curving, undulating terrain is great for dogs!

I like that I can use it while having lunch or shopping at Lalaport.

I often use it because it's sometimes available for private play on weekdays.

This time, we had lunch at Ron Herman Cafe before heading home♪

The store was ok, nice selection of treats and frozen meals. But the cages with the puppies for sale were not good at all. They were too young to be sitting in separate cages, no shelter, and they clearly missed their mother and siblings. On was showing obvious signs of stress and panick, nobody paid any attention. Very sad to watch.

Person to Watch Out For: Last Saturday evening, a petite woman in her 40s with short bob hair, brown hair, small eyes, and wearing what looked like vintage Alhambra jewelry—a self-proclaimed investor—suddenly told me I was in the way and pushed my dog's cart twice. Luckily, I wasn't injured, but my dog ​​was trembling when I checked on him immediately. I also felt the impact.

A third time, she tried to push, and when I stopped her and held the cart, she claimed my foot got caught in the tire (my own fault) and demanded compensation (which I naturally refused, as it was ridiculous). She also hurled a lot of other abusive language that would probably be flagged as inappropriate by AI if I wrote it all here; it was very frightening. Her husband (or perhaps her husband?) tried to calm her down, but she bit him with incredible force. It seemed like this was a regular occurrence, and there was nothing the man could do; I felt very sorry for him.

Her eyes looked a little strange, and what she was saying was somewhat incoherent, so I think she's that kind of person. I hope the store installs proper security cameras with audio recording. I was suddenly pushed, and there were no store employees or security guards nearby, which was very frightening (I think the woman pushed the cart knowing this).

Also, since she demanded money, I wondered if she might be a repeat offender who scams people, and if someone has paid her in the past. Someone with a weak will might just give in and pay.

I've informed the store staff, so she might not come back, but I wanted to share this so that no one else becomes a victim. Please be careful if you're bringing your dog.
I believe our grooming techniques and the products we offer are the best in Tokyo.
They have a great selection! I'm also happy that they carry the RosieDays brand.

Last year, I left my dog ​​with the staff for about two hours, and when I was leaving, they told me that it looked like he'd defecate, but they couldn't find anything and that he might have eaten it. When my dog ​​arrived and I was walking to the car, I noticed a bad smell, so I looked at him and saw that he had poop all over his hind legs. I was left feeling suspicious because they didn't check his whole body despite saying he might have defecate, and I wondered if he'd been confined in a small space where poop got on his legs.
Very friendly and helpful staff. The advice is excellent!

Go here often to shop, trim nails, etc. Good selection and friendly staff.

Unfortunately they have people who look like they have influenza (visibly very sick) doing some of these services mentioned above. Sick staff should stay home and rest, not touch 100s of dogs.

I went shopping for clothes.

I was grateful that I could try them on.

There was urine left near the snack section, so I think it would be better to make dog diapers mandatory.

I used the dog run and temporary dog ​​daycare.

The dog run was clean and decent, neither particularly good nor bad, and my dog ​​had a fun time playing!

The temporary dog ​​daycare was available on the same day, which was great since I came alone!

I was a little surprised when, after I said I wanted to use it, my dog ​​was quickly taken away somewhere. The staff didn't seem busy, so I wonder what they were rushing around for.
A very large pet store where you can find everything for your pet, even a professional groomer.🥰 …

I was so sad because the staff were so cold. This is the first time I've ever been to such a cold pet shop.

My dog ​​peed in the store, and when I called a staff member, I expected them to go to the back to clean it up or lend me something to use, but they never came back. When I called another staff member, they ignored me and were on their phone.

When I called yet another staff member, all they said was, "Clean it up yourself." I desperately searched my bag for something to use and tried to clean it up with the only tissue I found, but of course it was impossible. When I tried to buy something from the store to use, they said, "Oh, the cleaning supplies are over there... haha." I wish they had told me that from the beginning, and everyone's tone was so scary I almost cried. This is the first time I've ever experienced something like this.

I understand if they were too busy to help, but there were only a few staff members in the store.

They seemed kind and smiling when they were assisting customers with expensive dogs, so it's probably a good store for customers buying expensive dogs.
